# pursue-index

> Citable archive of the U.S. Department of War PURSUE UAP document releases.
> Primary-source documents, OCR transcripts, page-level citations.
> Source: https://pursueindex.com

## Meta

- [Methodology](https://pursueindex.com/methodology): How the corpus is fetched, hashed, OCR'd, and made reproducible.
- [About](https://pursueindex.com/about): What pursue-index is, and what it is not.
- [How to cite](https://pursueindex.com/cite): Citation patterns for the corpus, individual cards, and OCR transcripts.
- [Support](https://pursueindex.com/support): Operator contact + funding posture.
- [API](https://pursueindex.com/api): Machine-readable endpoints (manifest, pages, embeddings).
- [Removed](https://pursueindex.com/removed): Cards dropped entirely from the upstream manifest; bytes preserved here.
- [Altered](https://pursueindex.com/altered): Cards where upstream re-published bytes under the same identifier. Operator review confirmed 0 content edits; this surface now documents that finding. Bytes-changed receipts remain on each card page.
